source-control.what: GATE3/4 source-mesh portal corners, manually marked in new frames, vs projection through the registered pose
source-control.rationale: March registration itself fits these corners at 4.1 px RMS / 6.7 px max @960 (= 5.5 / 8.9 px @1280)

class-a-plane.what: segment sparse points (>=3 views, err<=2 px, tri>=2 deg) inside each March class-a plane's supported box

plumb.what: vertical vanishing direction from LSD near-vertical segments vs registered camera up

floor-diagnostic.what: segment points within |Y|<0.3 on the corridor floor; Ground_Floor Y=0 is a GENERATED fill, diagnostic only

cross-video.what: same physical point triangulated independently in two new-epoch segments, distance after both registrations

verdicts.upgraded-to-a: independent new-epoch evidence meets every class-a number and agrees with (or replaces) the March geometry
verdicts.confirmed: March geometry already class a and new-epoch held-out numbers pass
verdicts.still-failing: new evidence insufficient or numbers short of class a
verdicts.contradicted: new-epoch evidence meets class-a numbers but disagrees with March geometry by > 0.10 u (plane offset) or > 3 deg (normal)
